items.heading: Logistics Remains a Genuinely Strong
items.text: Logistics remains a genuinely strong field in India in 2026, but the honest answer to "is it good" depends heavily on which lane you actually mean and whether you have a realistic plan to move upstream over time.

items.heading: Before Pay, Automation Risk,
items.text: Before pay, automation risk, or growth strategy, there is a structural question worth settling first, because it changes what the rest of 's advice actually applies to for you.

items.heading: A Single "Logistics Salary
items.text: A single "logistics salary in India" figure hides more than it reveals, because an analytical supply chain planner with a few years of experience can out-earn an operations executive who has stayed purely execution focused for far longer.

items.heading: Operations Roles (Warehouse, Transportation, Fleet
items.text: Operations roles (warehouse, transportation, fleet management) run the physical movement and storage of goods day to day, hands-on, execution-focused work with real accountability for on-time delivery and cost control.

items.heading: Supply Chain and Planning Roles
items.text: Supply chain and planning roles (demand forecasting, procurement, inventory optimisation) sit further upstream, working with data and vendor relationships to decide what moves where and when, before execution happens.

items.heading: Logistics Management and Leadership Roles
items.text: Logistics management and leadership roles oversee both, owning cost, service-level, and vendor-network decisions across a whole region or category, usually reached after solid operational or planning experience.
